resources.string: Help
AstroClock measures time by consistent astronomical standards in stead of months and years with changing amount of days.\nCycles\nTime is measured according to three natural cycles:

string.name: daycycle
string.li: Day \t One rotation every 24 hours. Hand at 12 o\'clock position at mid-day.

string.name: mooncycle
string.li: Moon\t One rotation every 29.53 days. Hand at 12 o\'clock position at full moon.

string.name: yearcycle
string.li: Year\t One rotation every 365.25 days. Hand at 12 o\'clock postion at the longest day of the year.

resources.string: The hands always turn in clockwise direction but the 12 o\'clock positions could be different in some themes.
Sun rise & Sun set\nWithin the day cylce are indicators showing the start and end of day and night.
Status Bar Notifications\nBy enabling alerts you can receive up to 12 different recurring notifications, even when your screen is off.
Homescreen\nAstroClock also comes with a homescreen widget and a battery efficient live wallpaper.
Make your own Theme\nFor instructions on creating your own theme and sharing it with others, please visit android.arnodenhond.com/apps/astroclock/skins
Receive Broadcasts\nAstroClock sends out broadcast intents which other apps can receive. See android.arnodenhond.com/apps/astroclock/broadcast-intents for more information.
Disclaimer\nThis app does not contain spyware or otherwise misbehave in any way. Some screens are known to burn in afterimages when displaying the same graphics over a long period.
